zh-CN: 新增“实验室 → 框选提问”，支持翻译、总结、提问和可选的本机语音转写。框选功能需要 macOS 14 或更新版本。
扩展模型服务的可选型号，支持读取可用模型列表、手动填写模型 ID 和兼容端点；实际可用性取决于服务与账户。
新增 16 种可保存的翻译目标语言，可在框选设置和翻译回答中切换，独立于界面语言。
补齐内置作品名、实验室与框选操作的英文显示，统一灰色界面；将“发送图片”放到“按住说话”下方，图片输入需模型支持。
完善权限与实际监听状态检查；修复未连接键盘时正常备份导致的退出误提示，并避免启动时恢复为过大的窗口。
en: Add Labs → Ask about a selection with translation, summaries, questions and optional local speech transcription. Selection requires macOS 14 or later.
Expand model choices with supported account catalogs, manual model IDs and compatible endpoints. Availability depends on the provider and account.
Add 16 saved translation-language choices in selection settings and translation answers, independent of the interface language.
Complete English labels for built-in artwork, Labs and selection controls, unify the gray interface, and place the image switch below Hold to speak. Image input requires model support.
Improve permission and listener-readiness checks, fix an unnecessary quit warning for valid backups while the keyboard is disconnected, and prevent oversized restored launch windows.
